purpose: Per-stage profile of a full scan on a large real project, and throwaway prototypes of four optimizations. Evidence for docs/PERFORMANCE_PLAN.md. Not a release measurement.

environment.machine: Android/aarch64 phone, Ubuntu in proot (syscalls are intercepted, so filesystem-heavy stages are inflated relative to native Linux)
environment.target: aarch64 glibc (the shipped Linux binary is static musl and was not measured)
environment.noise: Thermal and scheduling variance is large. The same stage varied by 20-40% between runs; baseline selection ranged 57-101 s. Read the numbers as orders of magnitude.

source.instrumentation: Benchmark-only spans (Instant + atomics) around stages; prototypes toggled at run time with an environment variable so one executable measured every variant.
source.prototype_scope: Scratch copy outside the repository. No production file was changed.

command: ts-crap --root corpus/vscode --on-syntax-error report --format json --output out.json (no coverage, no baseline)

variants.kind: Per-grammar flag tables indexed by kind_id, cached field ids, one buffered SHA-256 update stream per function
variants.sel: Walked entries: each directory checked for symlinks once per scan; no per-file canonicalize
variants.pre: DestinationPlan::validate compares (dev, ino) from one lstat for regular files instead of stat + open + fstat
variants.par: std::thread::scope workers pulling file indexes from an atomic counter; results merged in file order (naive: unbounded result buffer)

baseline_stage_profile_ms.note: Unpinned run with an existing output file, so both validation walks ran. Spans nest: collect is inside analyze; metrics and hash are inside collect.

runs_pinned_to_cores_4_to_7.note: taskset -c 4-7, output file absent (no validation walk), run back to back.

download_measurements_v2_4_0.note: Measured from the same proot machine; byte counts are exact, seconds are indicative.
